verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents a Provider package type that connects it to external APIs, plus managed resources such as an AWS RDS instance, and the vendor claims it can 'manage any resource anywhere' using a library of components. Community comments describe cloud-specific controllers that keep apps portable across AWS, Azure and others. However, the evidence never shows the actual breadth of the provider ecosystem. missing for 10: a documented catalog of providers covering GCP, Azure and other major clouds, any evidence of SaaS provider coverage, and independent hands-on confirmation of multi-cloud provider breadth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage resources across all major clouds and SaaS providers through a broad provider ecosystem
